mapper.select: SELECT r.id repository_id,r.owner_account_id,o.display_name owner_display_name,p.permission_level,r.ownership_version,r.repository_status FROM repositories r JOIN accounts o ON o.id=r.owner_account_id LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId} WHERE r.id=#{repositoryId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r.owner_account_id=#{accountId} OR p.account_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT r.id repository_id,r.owner_account_id,o.display_name owner_display_name,NULL::text permission_level,r.ownership_version,r.repository_status FROM repositories r JOIN accounts o ON o.id=r.owner_account_id WHERE r.id=#{repositoryId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.id FROM repositories r LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId} WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r.owner_account_id=#{accountId} OR p.account_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id
SELECT id FROM repositories WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT r.id repository_id,r.owner_account_id,o.display_name owner_display_name,p.permission_level,r.ownership_version,r.repository_status FROM repositories r JOIN accounts o ON o.id=r.owner_account_id LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id WHERE r.id=#{repositoryId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at,p.account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_permissions(account_id,repo_id,permission_level,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{accountId},#{repositoryId},#{permission},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(account_id,repo_id) DO UPDATE SET permission_level=EXCLUDED.permission_level,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM repository_permissions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE repositories SET owner_account_id=#{newOwnerId},name=#{newName},normalized_name=#{normalizedName},ownership_version=ownership_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{repositoryId} AND ownership_version=#{expectedVersion} AND repository_status IN ('READY','AUTH_ERROR') AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repositories WHERE owner_account_id=#{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
